content.title: D-backs Games: How to Watch | Arizona Diamondbacks
content.text: How do I stream the D-backs games in the Arizona area?MLB.TV subscribers in Arizona are subject to blackouts and other restrictions in-market. MLB.TV subscribers would only be able to view D-backs games while out of market. DBACKS.TV subscribers will be able to stream D-backs games in the Arizona area with NO BLACKOUTS (subject to national exclusivities). To purchase a DBACKS.TV subscription, click here, and be sure to select this specific package. This offer is only for D-backs fans in the Club’s Home Television Territory and is a separate service than the MLB.TV out of market package.How do I watch D-backs baseball if I live outside of the Arizona area?Existing out-of-market Yearly and Monthly MLB.TV subscribers, including subscribers who received a subscription via T-Mobile, can continue to watch Arizona Diamondbacks games on MLB.TV outside of the Arizona area. Non-subscribers will need to purchase an MLB.TV Yearly or Monthly subscription in order to watch. Full details on all MLB.TV product offerings can be found here.Can MLB.TV All Teams Subscribers Watch D-backs games on MLB.TV in the Arizona area?Only users that have specifically purchased the 2026 DBACKS.TV subscription will be able to stream D-backs games in the Arizona area. MLB.TV All Teams subscribers will not have access and will need to purchase DBACKS.TV in addition to the All Teams Package in order to stream D-backs games on MLB.TV in Arizona.If I’m a D-backs Advantage Member / Season Ticket Member with MLB.TV, what does this mean for me?D-backs Season Ticket Members receive a free MLB.TV All Teams Subscription as a membership benefit. However, only users that specifically purchase a DBACKS.TV subscription will be able to stream D-backs games in Arizona. Members need to add-on this package. Members should not enable their free MLB.TV All Teams subscription to watch D-backs home games. Instead, they should enable their subscription for DBACKS.TV.What talent will be broadcasting and calling the games on the new MLB broadcast?The D-backs primary TV broadcasters - Steve Berthiaume and Bob Brenly - will continue to serve in their existing roles.MLB.TV Blackout PolicyDue to certain Major League Baseball national exclusivities, select regular season, special event, and Postseason games are unavailable on MLB.TV domestically and internationally. Live audio of all 30 MLB teams is included with Dbacks.TV subscriptions.Web: Select the Arizona Diamondbacks game you wish to view from the Multimedia Center. You will be prompted to enter your Username and Password. As long as the computer meets the system requirements then you can log in with your registered email address and password to access your subscription from anywhere at any time. Sharing of your username and password is strictly prohibited. For more information, please click here. Mobile & Connected Devices To watch Arizona Diamondbacks games on mobile and connected devices, download the MLB app and select the game you wish to view. You will be prompted to enter your Username and Password. Sharing of your username and password is strictly prohibited. For more information, please click here. Device AvailabilityFor a full list of supported devices click here.DBACKS.TV SupportIf you are having issues accessing a game or have questions about your account you can visit our full online Support Page. You can also call our toll-free support (866.244.2291), email by clicking here, on Social @MLBFanSupport or via Virtual Assistant.Free Trial PolicyYou may cancel a 7-day risk-free trial of DBACKS.TV Yearly or DBACKS.TV Monthly any time during the 7-day window and will still have access to DBACKS.TV for the full 7 days. If you do not cancel, you will be billed on the 8th day for the current Yearly or Monthly subscription price. MLB reserves the right to determine customer eligibility for trial memberships in its sole discretion.If you purchased the DBACKS.TV subscription, the payment card you have on file with us will be billed monthly on approximately the same monthly date that you originally purchased, with monthly billing for each month of the 2026 MLB season through and including October. You can verify your monthly billing date in your MLB Account under “Manage Subscriptions.MLB.TV Device Availability, Support and Free Trial Policy InformationFor more information about device availability, customer support and free trial policies, visit the MLB.TV FAQ page.
